remarks: Rare opportunity to own a buildable vacant lot in a small private beach community near Bennett Beach on the shores of Lake Erie with beach access included. Located on Lakeshore at the corner of Pinehart, this nearly 1/3 acre parcel offers a desirable setting in a quiet community with only a handful of homes surrounded by woods on both sides. Since purchasing, the current owner has removed many large trees and helped prepare the property to be closer to build ready, creating a more open and usable site for the next owner’s vision. Enjoy the charm of a private setting with nearby access to Bennett Beach, Lake Erie recreation, summer sunsets, and the relaxed lifestyle that makes this area special. The property is also approximately a 5 minute drive from The Beach Club at Mickey Rats, a well known Angola beach bar and seasonal entertainment destination offering lakefront dining, live music, and nightlife. The surrounding area provides easy access to Angola, Derby, Hamburg, local restaurants, marinas, parks, and year round Western New York destinations. Whether envisioned as a seasonal retreat, year round residence, or future rental property, this lot offers flexibility in a limited inventory lakeshore location. The community is believed to be rental friendly (STR and LTR), with a current waterfront property operating as a short-term rental, creating added appeal for those considering seasonal, short term, or long term rental potential. A rare chance to secure land in an established private beach community close to Bennett Beach and Lake Erie.
